title: Live Project Window And Stack Finalization
objective: Finalize the LeafOS operator inlet with a minimal active TUI command language that can repeatedly improve any live project from a README, skeleton, and JSON seed.
constraints: Reuse version-2 work orders and typed task controls.
Do not give TUI renderers filesystem or shell authority.
Do not require an operator objective when project facts are sufficient.
Do not display or persist private model chain-of-thought.
acceptance: leafctl live opens the active project TUI
minimal and natural TUI commands reach the authoritative inlet
Project discovery and repeated iteration are deterministic
three-file seeds are supported without a separate executor
native C and Python renderers share one command contract
